_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Shows each image to the human in a card with its vehicle, view and paint. The human already sees the pictures: do not paste the images or their URLs again; mention expiry or that it is a preview in a sentence.

description: Free, no account needed. The picture of a catalog vehicle that its public page on carimage.dev already shows, when one is stored: a 600 px WebP with ready-to-paste markdown, the view and paint it is in, and every stored view and paint. Never renders: another view, paint or size, or a vehicle with nothing stored, is an image from the account server (create_car_image_urls, 1 credit). Pass the vehicle id from resolve_vehicle or search_vehicles, plus the view and color the human asked for. Say it is a preview, and name its view and color when they differ from the request.

color.description: The paint the human asked for, if any (a preset, a CSS color name or a hex). Preferred when a picture in that paint is stored; never recolored here.

vehicle.description: Stable vehicle id such as veh_395yw8tn73ff8, as resolve_vehicle (params.vehicle_id), search_vehicles and decode_vin return it. The preferred way to name a vehicle: it cannot be misspelled. It names the make, model and year, so omit those when it is given.

view.description: The view the human asked for, if any. A stored picture in that view is preferred; otherwise the vehicle page's main picture is returned and the result says which view it is.

name: preview_car_image
title: Preview a stored car image
